name: Calcitriol
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Calcitriol is active vitamin D for secondary hyperparathyroidism and low calcium in chronic kidney disease (CKD). Its dose is titrated to serum calcium, phosphorus and parathyroid hormone (PTH), not reduced for kidney function. The half-life at least doubles in kidney failure.
kidney_function_basis: Label indication for predialysis CKD uses creatinine clearance (Ccr 15 to 55 mL/min).

bands.recommendation: No CKD indication at this level in the label.
bands.short: No CKD indication at this level

bands.recommendation: Predialysis secondary hyperparathyroidism (label: Ccr 15 to 55): start 0.25 mcg/day; may increase to 0.5 mcg/day.
Predialysis: start 0.25 mcg/day; may increase to 0.5 mcg/day (label).
Label indication covers Ccr 15 to 55; below 15 not on dialysis is not addressed. Specialist input.

hd.text: Start 0.25 mcg/day; increase by 0.25 mcg/day every 4 to 8 weeks; check calcium at least twice weekly during titration. Most hemodialysis patients respond to 0.5 to 1 mcg/day (label).

pd.text: Dialysis-patient dosing as above applies (label lists dialysis without modality restriction). Calcium-free dialysate PD has been used for hypercalcemia (label).

dialyzable: Not stated. Hypercalcemia in dialysis patients can be corrected by dialysis against a calcium-free dialysate (label).
monitoring: Serum calcium at least twice weekly during titration; phosphorus, magnesium, alkaline phosphatase periodically; stop if hypercalcemia until normocalcemia (label). Follow KDIGO CKD-mineral and bone disorder (CKD-MBD) targets.

pediatric.approved_ages: Predialysis CKD: pediatric patients (label corrects Ccr to 1.73 m2 in children). Hypoparathyroidism: 1 year and older.
pediatric.usual_dose: Predialysis: 0.25 mcg/day in children 3 years and older; under 3 years, 10 to 15 ng/kg/day (label).

renal.recommendation: Predialysis dosing as above (label Ccr 15 to 55, corrected to 1.73 m2).

hd.text: Label dialysis dosing is not age-specific; pediatric dialysis dosing: specialist input.

pd.text: Label PK data include children 8 to 16 years on peritoneal dialysis; dose: specialist input.

pediatric.egfr_equation: Bedside Schwartz: eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.413 x height (cm) / serum creatinine (mg/dL)

adult: Ketteler 2017 cited only for the existence of KDIGO CKD-MBD targets; no specific numbers drawn from it.
Label (ANI, NDA021068) is old-format; predialysis band (Ccr 15–55) straddles our bands.
pediatric: Pediatric dialysis dosing is not explicit in the label; 'pediatric patients 3 years and older' wording appears under predialysis only.
